items.quote: And Moses besought the LORD his God, and said
why doth thy wrath wax hot against thy people
items.claim: God's wrath waxes hot against his people

items.quote: which thou hast brought forth out of the land of Egypt with great power, and with a mighty hand
items.claim: God brought the people forth out of Egypt with great power and a mighty hand
items.mechanism: great power, and with a mighty hand

items.quote: Wherefore should the Egyptians speak, and say, For mischief did he bring them out, to slay them in the mountains, and to consume them from the face of the earth?
items.claim: The Egyptians would claim that God brought them out for mischief to slay them in the mountains
items.action: speak, say, bring them out, slay them, consume them
items.place: the mountains, the face of the earth

items.quote: Turn from thy fierce wrath, and repent of this evil against thy people
items.claim: Moses urges God to turn from his fierce wrath and repent of the evil against his people
